name: Monster picker
notes: Invisible: shows the chosen monster's big portrait, bobbing. Left / Right pick another (it slides and cries). Only the first 'unlocked' monsters can be played (Furrbit, Emberpup and Splashell at first, then one more, in roster order, for the first win of each monster); a locked one shows as a dark silhouette (pal_locked) without its cry, the text under it says LOCKED / WIN WITH A NEW MONSTER, and START on it buzzes (sfx_error). START on an unlocked one resets the run's variables, draws the run's world at random (any of the 9, never locked), saves the pick and starts the run. SELECT opens the 'clear saved progress' question.
